terms.comment: Morgan–Owens explicitly records the chute sense, citing Levine. This is not the photographic slide sense.
Our household word, a description: a sloping board. It stands beside Morgan–Owens’s phrase because it says what the thing is.

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
